title: LINE theme color skins - measured color data (unofficial)
source: LINE Creators Market color skin screen (theme 5917994), rendered pixels measured 2026-11-25. NOT official published values.
method: Tiles and previews are CSS-rendered (no image files). Colors sampled from rendered pixels: tile surface = mode of 3-point 3x3 averages; circles/text = 36x36 region histograms; passcode and talk previews = region histograms of the Android-row preview.

accuracyLegend.official: Published by LINE (none in this file)
accuracyLegend.sampled: Measured from rendered pixels of the official screen; may differ from true CSS values by a few RGB steps

findings: CORRECTION to the trial assumption: the tile surface color is NOT the header color in most skins. The actual talk-room header band matches the tile's lower strip color, so 'header' in this file holds the strip color (cross-checked against talk previews for at least one skin per group, and bubble colors matched tile circles in all 50 skins). 'tileSurface' is kept separately because the app may want it for skin-picker tiles.
Bubble correspondence holds for all 50 skins: left circle = otherBubble, right circle = ownBubble, 'T' letter color = text color on that bubble.
Passcode backgrounds often reuse the surface/strip/own-bubble colors but sometimes are independent colors; all values here are individually measured, not derived.
Talk-room background color is a theme-side setting, not a skin property, so it is intentionally not part of skin colors.
Menu (bottom tab bar) color was not acquired; null means not acquired.
Per-platform rendering differences (iOS 26 liquid glass / legacy iOS / Android) are not verified; treat OS-specific rendering as a separate layer from this shared color data.
usageNote: Measured numeric data only; no official images or templates are included. Treat as a private reference for the user's own app; do not claim these are official LINE values.
